name: KLineChartQuant
description: DTCG Resolver Module 2025.10 entry point. Two orthogonal modifiers: preset (pro, exchange, terminal, zen, quant) x mode (light, dark). Scheme files carry both modes side by side under `light.*` / `dark.*`; preset contexts override those branches; the mode context is a generated selector that aliases the chosen branch onto the public names (`color.*`, ...). Aliases resolve after all sources merge (Resolver 2025.10 §resolution), so presets reach every mode without the modifiers depending on each other. Built by `pnpm tokens:build` (Style Dictionary v5 + permutation script, since SD resolver support is not shipped: style-dictionary#1590).

foundation.description: Mode- and preset-independent tokens: the legacy Theme families plus the v2 foundation groups.

scheme.description: Pro base values for both modes, namespaced `light.*` and `dark.*`: colors, elevation recipes, accent text tints.

preset.description: Visual preset. Pro is the base scheme; the others map a 14-field VisualPalette per mode onto the color roles.

mode.description: Color mode. Each context is a generated selector (mode/*.tokens.json) aliasing one scheme branch onto the public token names.
